name: AlertDialogPreview
description: The alert surface in the page flow, for documentation. Real parts, non-modal.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Visible label for cancelling or dismissing the request.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Visible label naming the outcome of the confirmation.

props.name: description
props.description: Additional content describing the value, state, or consequence.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: Label shown while the asynchronous action runs. Its width is reserved with the other feedback labels.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.
